EC1: Preoperative history of schizophrenia [OR], epilepsy [OR], parkinsonism [OR] or myasthenia gravis;
EC3: Inability to communicate in the preoperative period because of coma [OR], profound dementia [OR] or language barrier;
EC4: Preoperative obstructive sleep apnea (previously diagnosed as obstructive sleep apnea [OR], or a STOP-Bang score >= 3);
EC6: Preoperative left ventricular ejection fraction < 30% [OR], sick sinus syndrome [OR], severe sinus bradycardia (< 50 beats per minute), [OR]  or second-degree or above atrioventricular block [AND] [NOT] without pacemaker;
EC7: Severe hepatic dysfunction (Child-Pugh class C) or severe renal dysfunction (requirement of renal replacement therapy before surgery);
